Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.settings

Class SettingsManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.settings.SettingsManager
public class SettingsManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer Settings REST API client.

Covers global server settings, contact info, and per-workspace local settings. Two Spring controllers back this API:

  • Global/contact: src/restconfig/.../org/geoserver/rest/SettingsController.java (@RequestMapping path = "/settings")
  • Workspace-local: src/restconfig/.../org/geoserver/rest/LocalSettingsController.java (@RequestMapping path = "/workspaces/{workspaceName}/settings")

Endpoints covered


 GET    /rest/settings
 PUT    /rest/settings
 GET    /rest/settings/contact
 PUT    /rest/settings/contact
 GET    /rest/workspaces/{ws}/settings
 POST   /rest/workspaces/{ws}/settings
 PUT    /rest/workspaces/{ws}/settings
 DELETE /rest/workspaces/{ws}/settings

Usage example


 SettingsManager mgr = client.settings();
 GlobalSettings gs = mgr.getGlobal();
 gs.getSettings().setNumDecimals(6);
 mgr.updateGlobal(gs);
Since:
1.0.0

    • getGlobal

      public GlobalSettings getGlobal()
      Returns the full global server settings.
      Returns:
      global settings (settings, jai, coverageAccess sections)

    • updateGlobal

      public void updateGlobal(GlobalSettings settings)
      Updates the global server settings.

      Behavior: REPLACE — primitive fields (numDecimals, verbose, etc.) reset to 0/false when omitted from the request body. Recommendation: call getGlobal() first, modify the desired fields, then PUT the full body.

      Parameters:
      settings - updated global settings

    • getContact

      public Contact getContact()
      Returns the contact settings.
      Returns:
      contact settings

    • updateContact

      public void updateContact(Contact contact)
      Updates the contact settings.

      Behavior: MERGE — null fields (String type) are skipped, preserving existing values. Safe to send a partial body with only the fields to change.

      Parameters:
      contact - updated contact info

    • getWorkspaceSettings

      public WorkspaceSettings getWorkspaceSettings(String workspaceName)
      Returns workspace-local settings.

      Returns 200 even when no local settings exist — use WorkspaceSettings.hasLocalSettings() to check. A non-existent workspace name causes a 500 NPE on the server.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      Returns:
      workspace local settings

    • createWorkspaceSettings

      public void createWorkspaceSettings(String workspaceName, WorkspaceSettings settings)
      Creates workspace-local settings.

      Uses Accept: text/plain internally because the endpoint's @PostMapping declares produces = "text/plain" — appending .json causes 406.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      settings - local settings (workspace.name field required)

    • updateWorkspaceSettings

      public void updateWorkspaceSettings(String workspaceName, WorkspaceSettings settings)
      Upserts workspace-local settings (creates if absent, updates if present).

      Behavior: REPLACE — primitive fields reset to 0/false when omitted. A non-existent workspace name causes a 500 NPE on the server.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      settings - local settings (workspace.name field required)

    • deleteWorkspaceSettings

      public void deleteWorkspaceSettings(String workspaceName)
      Deletes workspace-local settings. The workspace falls back to global settings after deletion.

      Deleting when no local settings exist causes a 500 NPE (GeoServer bug). Call getWorkspaceSettings(String) first and check hasLocalSettings() before calling this method.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
